    {process}

    Every project moves through three steps.

    Step 01

    Discover

    We start with your business, your users and what the site has to achieve. No guesswork, just a clear brief everyone agrees on before a single screen gets designed.

    • Discovery call
    • User & competitor research
    • Sitemap & user flows
    • Timeline
    Step 02

    Design

    Wireframes become a polished interface built on a reusable design system. You see progress every few days in clickable Figma prototypes, not after weeks of silence.

    • Wireframes
    • UI design
    • Design system
    • Interactive prototype
    Step 03

    Deliver

    I build or hand off pixel-for-pixel, then test on real devices before launch. After go-live I stay around to tune what the analytics tell us.

    • Shopify / front-end build
    • QA on real devices
    • Launch
    • Post-launch support
